detail.longDescription: Wrt my previous post, yesterday I was setting up Affine on my SO's phone to finally get off our iCloud shared Notes Everything works well, get the app, configure the server URL, login in with OIDC... Woops, 503 error PocketID had been descheduled and left hanging after a failing node took the longhorn lock in its downfall A quick lock release and boom, we are back to business, all notes are in both of our phones, and with realtime editing ! # selfhost # selfhosted # selfhosting # homelab # affine # note # notes # notetaking # OIDC # sso # pocketid # kubernetes # longhorn # icloud # sovereignty # dataownership # apple # deapple
